description: UPI fraud can involve fake payment requests, fake cashback offers, QR codes, or social engineering designed to trick users into making payments or revealing sensitive information.
warning_signs: Someone asks for your UPI PIN to receive money
Unexpected cashback or reward offers
Unknown QR codes or payment requests
Pressure to make a payment immediately
safety_advice: Never share your UPI PIN
Do not enter a UPI PIN to receive money
Do not scan unknown QR codes
Verify unexpected payment requests independently

description: Phishing involves fake websites, messages, emails, or links designed to look legitimate and trick people into revealing passwords, OTPs, PINs or other sensitive information.
warning_signs: Suspicious or shortened links
Fake websites resembling banks or trusted services
Urgent requests to verify an account
Requests for OTP, PIN or password
safety_advice: Do not click unknown or unverified links
Check the website address carefully
Use the official website or app directly
Never share OTPs, passwords or PINs

description: Digital arrest scams involve criminals impersonating police, government officials or other authorities and using threats of arrest or legal action to pressure victims into transferring money or revealing information.
warning_signs: Caller claims to be a government or law enforcement official
Threats of immediate arrest
Demand for money to avoid legal action
Pressure to stay on a video or phone call
safety_advice: Do not transfer money because of threats
Do not share financial or personal information
Verify the claim through official channels
End suspicious calls and report the incident

warning_signs: Unexpected customer support call
Request for OTP or PIN
Request to install an unknown application
Pressure to provide remote access
safety_advice: Contact the company using its official website or app
Never share OTP, PIN or passwords
Do not install unknown applications
Do not give remote access to your device

warning_signs: Unexpected prize or cashback
Request to scan a QR code
Request to enter UPI PIN
Urgent deadline to claim a reward

Do not scan unknown QR codes

description: OTP fraud attempts to trick users into revealing one time passwords that can be used to authorize transactions or access accounts.
warning_signs: Someone asks you to share an OTP
Unexpected OTP messages
Caller claims to need an OTP for verification
Pressure to share the OTP immediately
safety_advice: Never share an OTP with another person
Check why an unexpected OTP was generated
Contact your bank or service provider through official channels
Report unauthorized transactions immediately

warning_signs: Guaranteed high returns
Pressure to invest immediately
Unknown investment platform
Requests to transfer money to personal accounts
safety_advice: Verify the investment company independently
Do not trust guaranteed return claims

Do not transfer money under pressure

description: Fake loan scams may advertise easy loans and then demand fees, personal information or payments before providing a loan.

Unexpected processing or security fees
Requests for sensitive banking information
Unknown loan applications or websites
safety_advice: Verify the lender independently

Check official regulatory information before proceeding
